name: Spearmint
shortDescription: Bright, minty leaves for a refreshing cup of tea.
description: Spearmint is a vigorous herb with textured green leaves and a fresh, cool scent. It spreads quickly when happy.
use: Fresh tea, salads, cool drinks and sauces.
growingTips: Grow in sun or partial shade and keep the soil moist. A pot helps stop its roots spreading through the garden.
